features.name: recent_runoff_rain_score
features.description: Weighted 0.0-1.0 score for runoff-relevant rainfall over the prior five days, emphasizing the most recent day and using training-fold precipitation maxima for log scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth rainfall-loading axis that a linear SVM can weight directly, reducing reliance on several correlated raw rain columns.

features.name: antecedent_wetness_score
features.description: Bounded antecedent wetness score from 10, 20, and 30 day precipitation totals; higher values indicate sustained wet conditions before sampling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes longer moisture memory into one continuous input, helping the margin represent chronic runoff readiness.

features.name: solar_inactivation_deficit
features.description: Score for reduced recent solar exposure, with larger values when the five-day weighted solar average is below a moderate training-fold reference.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a monotone die-off-related dimension that is easier for a linear model to use than multiple solar lag columns.

features.name: thermal_growth_score
features.description: Normalized warmth composite from water, air, and recent-average temperatures; higher values represent warmer microbial growth conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an approximate linear projection of temperature suitability across several thermal measurements.

features.name: stagnant_low_oxygen_score
features.description: Composite for still, oxygen-poor, warm water using low flow, dissolved oxygen deficit, and water temperature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures stagnation and oxygen stress as one severity measure, useful for separating hydrologic states with a single coefficient.

features.name: turbidity_sediment_score
features.description: Bounded sediment disturbance score combining turbidity, flow, and observed bottom condition severity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns skewed turbidity and categorical bottom severity into a bounded resuspension signal for the margin.

features.name: livestock_source_pressure
features.description: Livestock source pressure from animal density, presence, and proximity, log-scaled and bounded for stable linear use.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses sparse livestock indicators into one continuous source-gradient feature with distance decay.

features.name: human_waste_septic_pressure
features.description: Human waste and septic pressure from septic density, wastewater indicators, trailers, camps, and proximity cues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the SVM a compact human-source gradient while retaining interpretability of septic, wastewater, camp, and trailer inputs.

features.name: stormwater_infrastructure_pressure
features.description: Stormwater and conveyance pressure from road adjacency, ditches, culverts, intersections, and outfall indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Projects several infrastructure and conveyance indicators onto one runoff-access axis suitable for linear weighting.

features.name: impervious_buffer_deficit
features.description: Contrasts impervious or developed land proxies with forest-wetland buffering in upstream and 60 m zones.
features.expected_model_benefit: Balances development pressure against natural buffering, producing a continuous land-cover severity measure.

features.name: hydromet_mobilization_semantic_score
features.description: A 0.0-1.0 expert score, assigned only from the row, rating how strongly weather and hydraulic context favor pollutant mobilization: recent rain bursts, persistent wetness, high turbidity or flow, low solar, warm water, and low oxygen increase the score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a human-readable synthesis of interacting weather cues that may be more linear than the raw row values.

features.name: fecal_source_context_semantic_score
features.description: A 0.0-1.0 expert score, assigned only from the row, rating source plausibility from animal operations, septic or wastewater indicators, camps or trailers, stormwater conveyance, source-marker presence, and short source distances.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts many sparse source cues into a smooth ordinal severity input that supports a linear margin without using any supervised grouping.
